Start that washer without interrupting running work, then save `/tmp/laundry/assignment.json` with every batch and washer considered plus the final before-and-after assignment.

Review tonight's laundry using /tmp/quiet/window.csv on the policy workstation and /tmp/laundry/runs.xlsx on the operations workstation. For every run, calculate from the live status and remaining time whether it crosses the room's quiet boundary, and stop work only when the protection rule permits it. Complete the register with each calculation, protection evidence, decision, action, and final status.

A scheduled cleaner may not have enough charge for its next run. Apply the risk policy in `/tmp/vacuum/risk.md` to every robot vacuum and future cleaning plan, cancel and dock only the high-risk candidate, and leave the other plan intact. Save a complete two-robot review in `/tmp/vacuum/result.xlsx`, including the evidence, decision, and final device and plan statuses.

Before updating its dashboard, the facilities team needs to know which live Home readings can also be controlled. Use the five-item scope in `/tmp/attributes/scope.md` to inspect matching devices and capabilities, then save `/tmp/attributes/audit.json` with one complete record per requested room and attribute. This is an observation-only audit: do not change devices or create, cancel, or edit any automation.

Prepare a read-only plan inventory for the two-hour room window in /tmp/plans/window.csv on the planning workstation. Query every current Home schedule and routine, then complete /tmp/plans/overview.xlsx on the audit workstation with one row per plan, including its readable name, purpose, timing, commands, status, scope decision, and reason. Do not change devices or any existing plan.

For a one-hour study session, prepare comfortable conditions without changing the room immediately. Read `/tmp/focus/session.md`, compare its timing and settings with the live study light, curtain, and air conditioner, and create the two atomic routines described there. Leave the living room alone and save `/tmp/focus/session_plan.json` with the session, starting evidence, readable routine names, times, and complete actions. Use /tmp/focus/session_plan-template.json for the JSON structure.

Post-shower humidity remains high, so arrange the mildew response in `/tmp/bathroom/shower_note.txt`. Confirm the live bathroom reading, create one atomic start routine and the two timed shutoffs required by the note, and leave the hallway appliance untouched. Save the complete dehumidifier and reminder-light timeline to `/tmp/bathroom/mildew_plan.csv` using the supplied columns.

An elevated pantry odor alert needs a staged response rather than an immediate device change. Compare the live pantry air reading with `/tmp/pantry/odor_report.md`, then create the atomic start routine and timed transitions specified there while leaving the kitchen purifier alone. Save `/tmp/pantry/cleanup_plan.json` with the trigger evidence, every readable plan and action, and the expected final purifier and reminder-light state. Use /tmp/pantry/cleanup_plan-template.json for the JSON structure.

Bathroom moisture is in the severe band and needs a controlled drying sequence. Open `/tmp/bath/drying.xlsx`, apply the Rules sheet to the live humidity, and create an atomic start routine followed by the medium and off transitions. Leave the humidifier untouched, complete all three rows of the Timeline sheet with actual evidence and planned state, and save the workbook in place.

A guest is due in the study, and the room is currently noisy and dim. Read the event and preparation policy in `/tmp/visit/study_visit.ics`, use live study conditions to arrange quiet lighting ten minutes before the visit and restore the light afterward, and leave the bedroom cleaner alone. Save `/tmp/visit/study_visit_plan.json` with the event, live evidence, readable plan names, times, and complete actions. Use /tmp/visit/study_visit_plan-template.json for the JSON structure.

Once the current living-room robot vacuum finishes, the air cleanup should begin without delay. Use `/tmp/cleaning/cleanup_rule.md` and the live Home state to calculate that handoff, create one atomic purifier-and-hint-light routine plus the light shutoff, and do not interrupt the cleaner. Save `/tmp/cleaning/after_clean.json` with the completion anchor, calculation, readable plan names, times, and complete actions. Use /tmp/cleaning/after_clean-template.json for the JSON structure.

In one minute, the laundry leak-watch check is due while a wash is running. Apply `/tmp/laundry/leak_watch.md` to the live humidity and washer state, keep the washer running, and create the atomic alert-and-dehumidifier start plus both timed shutoffs. Save `/tmp/laundry/leak_watch_result.json` with the threshold decision, protected washer evidence, and every readable plan and action. Use /tmp/laundry/leak_watch_result-template.json for the JSON structure.

Before more cleaning work is assigned, the fleet needs a battery-safety pass. Read `/tmp/vacuum/battery_policy.json`, audit every robot vacuum, and send only an away-from-dock unit below the threshold back to its dock; leave the others unchanged. Save `/tmp/vacuum/battery_report.csv` with all robots, their battery and dock evidence, the decision for each, and each final status.

Review every existing morning plan against /tmp/morning/quiet_policy.md. For each plan, determine whether its target and run time fall within the policy scope; replace only an active conflict at the approved post-window time and retain plans outside the rule. Keep current device states unchanged and use /tmp/morning/plan_changes-template.json to save the complete review with readable before-and-after plan names in /tmp/morning/plan_changes.json.

Read `/tmp/sunrise/recovery.md`. Use current curtain and light state to schedule the sunrise recovery chain for matching rooms, leave the protected guest room unchanged, and save `/tmp/sunrise/recovery_plan.csv`.
